mapper.select: SELECT l.mail_log_id::TEXT AS row_id, l.template_cd, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(l.to_email,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8') AS to_email, l.subject, l.content, l.status_cd, c.name AS status_name, l.error_msg, l.reg_id, TO_CHAR(l.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt FROM mail_log l LEFT JOIN code c ON c.code_id = l.status_cd AND c.p_code_id = 'MAIL00' WHERE l.mail_log_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_log (template_cd, to_email, subject, content, status_cd, error_msg, reg_id, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{templateCd}, ENCODE(ENCRYPT(CONVERT_TO(#{toEmail},'UTF8'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'HEX'), #{subject}, #{content}, #{statusCd}, #{errorMsg}, #{regId}, NOW(), #{regIp})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mail_log WHERE reg_dt < NOW() - (#{days} || ' days')::INTERVAL
